source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of predictive modelling and causality (PDF 87-88).

blocks.text: Predictive modelling aane wale nataij ka andaza lagane ke liye data use karti hai: machine learning models pichhle data ke naqsh parakh kar andaza lagate hain ke aage kya ho sakta hai. Andaze bohat se shobon mein mansooba bandi aur faislon mein madad dete hain, lekin yeh imkaan (probability) par mabni hote hain aur hamesha yeh nahi batate ke kuch kyun hota hai, is liye sabab (causality) samajhna bhi ahem hai.

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Mausam ke andaze jaisi misalein dein, aur poochein ke kya andaza wajah batata hai. Farq par guftagu karein.

Andazon ke nataij woh hain jo train hua model pichhle data se deta hai: aane wali qeematon ya waqiat ke andaze. In ki durusti data ke miyar aur achhi training par munhasir hai. Karobar market aur farokht ke andaze lagate hain; sehat ka shoba inhein tashkhees mein use karta hai.

Sabab (causality) batata hai ke waqia kyun hota hai: sabab aur asar ka rishta jis mein aik awamil doosre par seedha asar dalta hai. Yeh science ki tehqeeq mein ahem hai. Sirf data sabab nahi dikhata; tajrubaat, jo baqi awamil muqarrar rakh kar aik awamil badalte hain, aksar sabab pehchante hain. Sabab samajhna faisle behtar karta aur ghalat mafrooze se bachata hai.

blocks.caption: Andaza aur sabab
rows: Sabab aur asar ke rishte, aksar tajrubaat se
Pichhle number, hazri aur parhai ke ghanton se aakhri grade; pichhle mausam se kal ka darja hararat
Baqaida parhai se imtihan behtar; tambaku noshi se phephron ki bimari ka khatra
Farokht ke andaze, stock rujhan, bimari ka khatra, talaba ki karkardagi
Aise iqdamat chunna jo waqai nateeja badlein

blocks.text: Model asal sabab samjhe baghair bhi durust andaza laga sakta hai. Maslan garmiyon mein ice-cream ki farokht aur doobne ke waqiat saath barh sakte hain: aik doosre ka andaza deta hai, lekin dono ka sabab garam mausam hai. Jab tay karna ho ke kya badlein, to sabab janna zaroori hai.

blocks.alt: Baen panel, andaza (kya hoga?): number aur hazri jaisa pichhla data model mein jata jo mumkina aakhri grade ka andaza deta; wajah jaane baghair durust ho sakta. Daen panel, sabab (kyun hota hai?): sabab, baqaida parhai, se teer asar, behtar grades, tak; sabab tajrubaat se sabit jo aik awamil badal kar baqi muqarrar rakhein, maslan tambaku noshi se phephron ki bimari; do cheezon ka saath barhna sabab sabit karne ke liye kafi nahi.
blocks.caption: Andaza aur sabab (6.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Andaza 'aage kya?' ka jawab deta aur sabab 'kyun?' ka; achhe faislon ko aam taur par dono chahiye.

blocks.prompt: Model dekhta hai ke zyada kitabon wale talaba ke number zyada hain. Kya is se sabit hota hai ke kitabein khareedne se number barhte hain? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Yeh andaze ke liye mufeed naqsh dikhata hai, sabab nahi. Doosre awamil, jaise ghar walon ki madad ya parhne mein guzra waqt, dono ka sabab ho sakte hain; sabab dikhane ke liye aisa tajruba chahiye jo sirf kitabon ki tadaad badle.

items: Andaza pichhle naqshon se lagata hai ke kya ho sakta hai.
Sabab batata hai kyun: sabab aur asar, aksar tajrubaat se.
Saath badalte naqsh sabab ka saboot nahi.
